column1: # Always group 2, stage 0, id = 20000 + hundreds*100 + index.
#   4 CD_COMMAND_DISPLAY_LOAD_SEEK_CURRENT_VIEW ignores hundreds/index; if gCdCmdViewSeekPending is set, queues
#     stage/area/viewGetMappedIndex() with hundreds = spriteVariant, CD_COMMAND_LOAD_SEEK_ONLY, 0, 0 through
#     cdCmdEnqueueUnlessSceneAudioPending and clears gCdCmdViewSeekPending; queues nothing otherwise.
# Profiles 0..3 set gCdCmdViewSeekPending = 1 after queueing. Any other profile value leaves mode and offsets
# uninitialised stack bytes (no switch case) and still queues.
# --- how fsLoadFile's arguments move an upload (src/main/fs.c) ---
# fsLoadFile:427 stores imageXPageOffset in gFsImageXPageOffset and imageYOffset in gFsImageHeaderYShiftRows (both s8) and maps
# loadMode to gFsChunkLoadPolicy; _fsChunkReadyCallback:619 zeroes all three when the load completes.
#   CD_COMMAND_LOAD_DEFAULT 0 (and unknown values) -> chunk mode 0, everything loaded
#   CD_COMMAND_LOAD_SEEK_ONLY 1       -> _fsSeekToSector only, nothing read or uploaded
#   CD_COMMAND_LOAD_INIT_SOUND 2      -> chunk mode 1: sndScriptResetForArea, then the load ENDS at the first
#   CD_COMMAND_LOAD_RELOCATE_IMAGES 3 -> chunk mode 2: the relocation mode below
#   CD_COMMAND_LOAD_SKIP_BACKGROUND 4 -> chunk mode 3: background (bs) chunk read past, not copied or decoded
#   CD_COMMAND_LOAD_IMAGES_ONLY 5     -> chunk mode 4: ends at the first package/raw/bundle chunk; music chunks skipped
#   CD_COMMAND_LOAD_SKIP_SOUND 6      -> chunk mode 5: music chunks skipped
# Image chunk (strip columns, pe2img; fsBeginImageColumns:1608 and fsUploadImageStrips:1779), per FsImageColumn:
#   X: column.x + imageXPageOffset*64 halfwords when column.y >= 256 OR the mode is RELOCATE_IMAGES; else unchanged.
#      So under the default mode the page offset moves only columns in the lower half of VRAM (y >= 256);
#      under RELOCATE_IMAGES it moves every column.
#   Y: under RELOCATE_IMAGES the FIRST column of the table uploads at column.y + 128; every later column uses its
#      recorded y unchanged (fs.c:1786). Under every other mode y is unchanged. imageYOffset never touches image columns.
# CLUT chunk (FsImageChunk, pe2clut; _fsPrepareImageChunkUpload:344, used by fsUploadImageChunk):
#   X, w, h: unchanged; imageXPageOffset never touches a CLUT.
#   Y: header.y + imageYOffset only when header.y is in 245..255 (11 rows), under every mode;
#      under RELOCATE_IMAGES one more row is added to EVERY chunk (y + 1, plus the offset when in 245..255).
# So MENU (-8, -3, relocate): all image columns 512 halfwords left, first column 128 rows down, CLUT rows 245..255
#   land at y - 2 and other CLUTs at y + 1. PREVIEW (0, -2, default): CLUT rows 245..255 up 2, images untouched.
#   RELOCATED_PREVIEW (0, -2, relocate): first image column 128 rows down, CLUT rows 245..255 at y - 1, others y + 1.
# Group handling in fsLoadFile: group 0 requires hundreds 0 and indexes _gFsStage0Category0Sectors by index (index 0 sets
#   videoMode STREAMING, 1 NORMAL); groups 5 and 0x5A index their offset tables by index alone (hundreds ignored);
#   group 4 is read only for hundreds 1, forces chunk mode 0 and returns before the offsets are stored;
#   groups 1..3 look up hundreds*100 + index; any other group needs group/10 != 0 and looks up the full id
#   (group 8 with hundreds 1..3 sets gGameSession->field_4E); stage != 0 reads _gFsFolderFileSectors[index] of the published folder.
# src/main/fs.c:1517 fsScanIsoDirectory(bootMode 1): at cold boot the ISO file INIT.BS (16 sectors, not a
#   stage-zero file) is read as a background payload and MDEC-decoded as the startup image (boot.c:269, 274).
# src/main/stage.c:1233..1261 _mdecStepSceneImageDecode: a streamed scene's payload, described by _gMdecSceneImageHeader, carries its own
#   strip lists and image chunks; where its relocate flags are set the code itself sets gFsChunkLoadPolicy = 2 with
#   gFsImageXPageOffset = -8 (strip lists) or gFsImageHeaderYShiftRows = -3 (image chunks), the MENU profile's numbers, then
#   resets them. The data comes from the stream, not from a stage-zero file.
# src/main/stream.c:394 streamPollGameRestore: two MoveImage2 copies restore VRAM saved before a movie.
# src/title/title.c:654 displayUploadBackgroundImage x2 after file 2 decodes; title.c:235 textUploadPalettes.
# src/main/bootload.c load screens: the captions (BootCaption_*) are resident text, not files.
#   _gStageTransitionState->loadFileArgs). Nothing in src/ or include/ writes loadFileKey/loadFileArgs or sets
#   STAGE_REQUEST_FILE_LOAD (0x08000000); the id is unresolved and the path looks unreachable. No line emitted.
# Stage music: sequence 0 appears in the dryfield, night, shelter and neo ark tables and the akropolis countdown table;
#   it would compute 40100, which is not on the disc (fsLoadFile finds no sector and reads nothing). Whether a

column1: # --- Rules for the placement-driven actor loads (src/gameplay/area_cd.c); the edges themselves are already traced.
# Called from the area load in two passes (load_screen.c:105 and :111), after the room base file, with the variant from areaGetVariant(live save location).
# Pass 1, loadingPollAreaBaseResources (area_cd.c:163; enqueue at :160): walks EVERY AreaResource of the variant, not only placed ones, and queues its base file
#   (stage 0, group = _gLoadingAreaFileGroupBases[fileGroupIndex] {10,20,30,40,50,60,0,1,2} + fileNumber / 100, hundreds = fileNumber % 100, index 0, CD_COMMAND_LOAD_DEFAULT).
#   Exception: a resource with fileGroupIndex == AREA_RESOURCE_FILE_GROUP_BASE_60 (5, groups 60..) is loaded only when some placement has the same entryId AND fileIdLow == 0.
#   page/row = texturePageOffset/clutRowOffset of the first placement with the same entryId and fileIdLow == 0; 0/0 when there is none.
# Pass 2, loadingPollAreaPlacementFiles (area_cd.c:79; enqueue at :76): for every placement with entryId != 0 and fileIdLow != 0, queues the file with the same
#   group and hundreds as its resource and index = fileIdLow, with that placement's own page/row. So a placement's fileIdLow file is loaded IN ADDITION to the
#   base file (index 0) from pass 1 - except for a BASE_60 resource none of whose placements has fileIdLow == 0, where only the fileIdLow file is loaded.
#   The same fileIdLow file is queued once per placement naming it (no dedup in this code). Placements with entryId 0 or fileIdLow 0 queue nothing in pass 2.
#   If a placement's entryId matches no resource, the cursor is left on the resource terminator and its fields are used; not checked whether any room does that.
#   on the current view file, only when gCdCmdViewSeekPending is set; it positions the drive and loads nothing.
# _sndLoadTryEnqueuePeFile (scene_runtime.c:1299) queues a group-5 file with CD_COMMAND_LOAD_SEEK_ONLY and has no caller under src/.
# _attachmentEnqueueBattleSoundLoad (hud_sprites.c:1274) has no caller; attachmentSoundLoadStub (hud_sprites.c:1255) loads nothing, so the item-use paths for
#   indices 46, 49, 52 (item_use.c:365, 372) queue no file from gameplay: 50146 (flare), 50149 (pepper_spray), 50152 (combat_light) and 50100 have no loader in src/gameplay.
# itemMenuEnqueuePreviewLoad re-queues saved requests through _cdCmdEnqueueEntry (menu_armor.c:544); those are copies of requests already listed, not new files.
# loadingUploadCachedViewImage / loadingRestoreViewImageAndEnqueueResources upload a view image retained in gFsResourceSlots with fsUploadImageChunk, without a file load.
# --- Gameplay loaders called from other packages (their lines belong to those loaders)
# src/actors/actor_150400/actor_150400.c:448 calls loadingEnqueueCharacterResources(true): the costume file with CD_COMMAND_LOAD_IMAGES_ONLY, page 6.
# 20932 and 20935 (spk, beside the death files 20930/20931/20933/20934) are not selected by any gameplay path: deathVariant is only 1 or 2.
# Costume variant 5 (10600): no player-side writer found under src/gameplay; actor_800100 temporarily writes companionVariant into resourceVariant.
# Which costume a variant number means (and which companion types 2 and 3 are) is not established by the loading code; only the file ids are.
# Enemy preview ids (>= 0x500) and the objective byte for map help: value ranges not traced to their writers.
# Loads queued by src/main code on gameplay's behalf (stage.c:358, stage_music.c:269, stream.c:423, loadui.c disc-swap prompt 2016x) are loader main, not listed here.
